title: Elodie and the Autopsy
author: Dominic Brightwater
blurb: Felix Crane, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
